notes: Front Desk tells you when a newer version is out: Setup shows what's new and how to get it, and a banner on the main screen has a Not now button.
It checks once a day when the computer is online, by reading one small public file.
You can turn the check off in Setup, under Updates.
Setup's "Your data" now says plainly that this daily check is the one thing that goes online.
how: Shahien will send you the new installer. Install it over the old one; your records stay as they are.
